parsed.summary: The netlist and SPICE deck implement all specified functions: external 5V diode isolation, battery high-side switch, servo rail diode and bulk capacitors, MAX3485 UART path with auto DE/RE control, PWM series/jumper paths, and serial-mode signal bridging. The reference designators are renumbered relative to the specification, but the connectivity, component roles, and values are consistent with the intended design, so no electrical anomaly is supported.
